biological.citation: Biallelic variants in NUDCD2 associated with a multiple malformation syndrome with cholestasis and renal failure (PMID: 37272762)
biological.summary: Two unrelated patients with biallelic NUDCD2 variants had a multiple malformation syndrome: dysmorphic facies, midline brain hypoplasia, hypothyroidism, valve stenosis, liver and kidney failure, hypotonia and early death. Fibroblasts from a patient with biallelic loss-of-function variants lacked NUDCD2 protein. NUDCD2 is described as a Hsp90 co-chaperone that associates with LIS1, HERC2 and cohesin subunits and acts in cell migration and microtubule extension. The syndrome has ciliopathy-like features.

biological.citation: RetSat stabilizes mitotic chromosome segregation in pluripotent stem cells (PMID: 39172275)
biological.summary: In mouse ESCs, RetSat interacts with the cohesin/condensin components Smc1a and Nudcd2, as shown by immunoprecipitation and LC-MS/MS. RetSat deletion reduced the loading of Smc1a, Smc3 and Nudcd2 onto mitotic chromosomes. This links Nudcd2 to chromosome stability and segregation in pluripotent stem cells.

biological.citation: ASHG 2014 - The utility of clinical exome sequencing in identifying the genetic origins of eight unclassified developmental disorders in unique Canadian populations
biological.summary: Whole exome sequencing identified NUDCD2 as a new disease gene mutated in patients with ataxia, dystonia and mental retardation. NUDCD2 interacts with the lissencephaly-associated protein PAFAH1B1 (LIS1).
biological.sample_size: 19 patients by WES across 8 disorders (27 patients in 11 families overall)

biological.citation: Transcriptional response of the bovine endometrium and embryo to endometrial polymorphonuclear neutrophil infiltration as an indicator of subclinical inflammation of the uterine environment (PMID: 22781929)
biological.summary: NUDCD2 was downregulated in blastocysts from cows with subclinical endometritis (SE-7) compared with healthy cows (HE-7). The changes were among genes linked to membrane stability, cell cycle and apoptosis.

biological.citation: Unveiling the unexplored novel signatures for osteoporosis via a detailed bioinformatics and molecular experiments based approach (PMID: 38715824)
biological.summary: NUDCD2 was identified as one of eight hub genes among differentially expressed genes in osteoporosis (GSE35959). RT-qPCR in Pakistani osteoporosis patients confirmed significant downregulation, and ROC analysis showed diagnostic value.

biological.citation: Molecular prognosticators in clinically and pathologically distinct cohorts of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma-A meta-analysis approach (PMID: 31310629)
biological.summary: NUDCD2 was among the genes specifically altered in HPV+ HNSCC. Along with RPP25 and NOVA1, it showed an impact on survival in TCGA validation.
biological.sample_size: HPV-based meta-analysis, n=83 (8 microarray datasets), validated in TCGA

biological.citation: Study on biomarkers of homocysteine-induced transformation of vascular smooth muscle cells into foam cells (PMID: 41644998)
biological.summary: In homocysteine-treated VSMCs, proteomics (LFQ-DIA) found changed NUDCD2 protein levels. PRM validation confirmed the direction of change. NUDCD2 was one of 16 validated proteins, though the follow-up work focused on COX7C.

biological.citation: The role of dinutuximab beta with beta cell function, apoptosis, and proliferation: new approaches to proteomic analysis of insulinoma (PMID: 41123852)
biological.summary: LC-MS/MS proteomics of INS-1 insulinoma cells treated with dinutuximab beta detected NUDCD2 among altered proteins, together with ERP29, ARF1 and others. The protein ubiquitination pathway predominated among the altered pathways.
